toegepas.rede_vinder: Under the AWS 2017, 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb ('neem jy', 'speel jy'), so it takes a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'En' joins two sentences each with its own subject and verb ('neem jy', 'speel jy') without the AWS comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 rule the project follows; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Ná' meaning 'after' takes the acute accent so that it is not read as 'na' (towards).
toegepas.fout: Temporal 'na' at the start of the sentence lacks the accent.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Op plekke' is the idiom for 'here and there', so the definition can be misread; 'op verskillende plekke' says what is meant.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Op plekke' reads as the idiom 'here and there', so the definition can be misread.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the fix rewords a glossary definition, which only the writer may change.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
